text: Hello.

text: Erf.

text: Hello.
source_text: Hello.

text: I have a message from Romero.
source_text: I have a message from Romero.

text: May I ask your name, miss?
source_text: May I ask your name, miss?

text: I'm Julianna.
source_text: I'm Julianna.

text: Do you have a job here?
source_text: Do you have a job here?

text: Can I ask a little about your town?
source_text: Can I ask a little about your town?

text: I do what Caleb asks. But I am really only able to do a little farming. I don't have the skills to help Smitty or Miles out.
source_text:
I do what Caleb asks. But I am really only able to do a little farming.
 I don't have the skills to help Smitty or Miles out.

text: Tell me a bit about those others you mentioned.
source_text: Tell me a bit about those others you mentioned.

text: We survive, and the Regulators make sure that nothing happens to hurt us. Mostly by not letting us out of here.
source_text:
We survive, and the Regulators make sure that nothing happens to hurt us.
 Mostly by not letting us out of here.

text: Well, Miles does chemistry, and he makes bullets and things. Smitty is a craftsman who builds things like pots and knives.
source_text:
Well, Miles does chemistry, and he makes bullets and things.
 Smitty is a craftsman who builds things like pots and knives.

text: You have a message from Romero? What is it?
source_text: You have a message from Romero? What is it?

text: He says that he's through with you.
source_text: He says that he's through with you.

text: He says that he sends his love.
source_text: He says that he sends his love.

text: He sent this locket as a token.
source_text: He sent this locket as a token.

text: No . . . it can't be true . . . I . . .
source_text: No . . . it can't be true . . . I . . .

text: Did he do nothing else?
source_text: Did he do nothing else?

text: No, sorry.
source_text: No, sorry.

text: Oh yeah, he sent this locket.
source_text: Oh yeah, he sent this locket.

text: How romantic! Oh, I must see him somehow! If only . . . perhaps . . . maybe Lorraine can bring him a message . . .
source_text:
How romantic! Oh, I must see him somehow! If only . . .
 perhaps . . . maybe Lorraine can bring him a message . . .

text: Oh! Thank you so much for your help! We have decided to live here now, with the Followers, in peace. Thank you for supporting our love.
source_text:
Oh! Thank you so much for your help! We have decided
 to live here now, with the Followers, in peace.
 Thank you for supporting our love.

text: I cannot live without him!
source_text: I cannot live without him!

text: Julianna draws a knife and plunges it into herself!
source_text: Julianna draws a knife and plunges it into herself!
